visual_action: A woman speaks directly to the camera in a talking-head format. Behind her, an animated graphic visualizes a vote in the House of Representatives. The graphic first displays text accusing Republicans of voting against Americans. It then transitions to show a specific vote on a bill to fight gas price gouging, animating to fill in 217 'yes' votes from Democrats (in blue) and 203 'no' votes from Republicans (in red).

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The main on-screen text reads 'Republicans Repeatedly Vote Against Helping Americans' and a later graphic shows '203 REPUBLICANS VOTED NO'. The speaker also repeatedly refers to Republicans.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The speaker refers to 'Democrats' plan' and a graphic shows '217 DEMOCRATS VOTED YES'.

cast.name: unnamed speaker
cast.evidence: A woman appears on screen throughout the video, delivering the narration.

on_screen_text.text: Republicans Repeatedly Vote Against Helping Americans
House of Representatives Vote on a Bill That Would Fight Gas Price Gouging

spoken_summary: A woman asks viewers how many Republicans voted against a Democratic plan to address gas price gouging. She states that while 217 Democrats voted for a bill to fight it, 203 Republicans—every single House Republican—voted against it. She concludes this is one example of Republicans voting against bills that would help the American people.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of the woman's speech. There is no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot. The only edits are the animated graphics appearing in the background to illustrate the speaker's points.
central_claim: The Republican party unanimously voted against a bill designed to stop gas price gouging, demonstrating they do not act in the interest of the American people.
intended_effect: To generate anger towards the Republican Party and position the Democratic Party as the one fighting for ordinary Americans against corporate interests.
uncertainty_flags: The identity of the speaker is unknown.
